svg.title: A letter from Ángeles
svg.desc: YOU! HOW DARE YOU MERGE AN AI PR WITHOUT READING IT?! “ALL TESTS PASS”? WHERE. IS. THE. EVIDENCE?! MOCKS IN MY TEST SUITE! RUNBLOCKING IN A FLOW TEST! I AM ABSOLUTELY… DISGUSTED! …sorry. I promised you a polite Howler. Let me start again: hi, I'm Angie. I started in 2018, studying multiplatform app development. In 2020 I shipped my first Android code as an intern, and over the next two years I built an Android app from scratch: architecture, networking, persistence and release. That's where I learned to like things done properly. Since 2023 I've been at ALTEN, on an international fashion retail app used by millions. I took over the new shopping cart mid-rewrite and got it to production, moved the analytics from GA3 to GA4, and built the Python tool QA now uses to reconcile events from six analytics SDKs, and brought my AI-agent harness into the team's workflow. These days I'm on app health: R8 across the app and a high-precision hunt for dead code. Claude Code is my daily wand, at work and at home, and I'm building a harness around it. When I audited it on 8,466 real agent turns, I caught three gates reporting green without evidence. Since then I ask every AI feature the same question: what's the evidence? That's why I'm building ArIAdna, a Compose Multiplatform app that shows what an agent is really doing. Fittingly, it's being built by one: an unattended agent on my home server opens the pull requests, and I review every one and own every decision. What I'm looking for: a remote team (I'm in Madrid) building Android or KMP products, or developer tooling, where AI is part of the craft rather than a buzzword. If that's you, send an owl. — Angie

g.text: The envelope bursts into harmless pink sparks.
